source: proofs/lem-compcb-entrywise-compression-naturality (af-validated, taint clean). FULL VALIDATED CONTRACT: Entrywise compression naturality: there is a universal e_nat > 0 such that, whenever e = delta+epsilon <= e_nat, Q is a delta-projection in an extended epsilon-C*-algebra A, n >= 1, and E_{11} is the (1,1) matrix unit of M_n, every Z in A satisfies Co_{I_n tensor Q, I_n tensor Q}(E_{11} tensor Z) = E_{11} tensor Co_Q(Z).
